messages:
olivia_support: FYI — EduCom procurement says they will not accept an invoice until we receive a signed purchase authorization. They mentioned it’s policy for education partners. Also noted they hit a 403 when trying to update payment details via our billing UI.

mike_billing: Can we issue anything before a PO lands? Contract (EDU-2025-09) looked like 'preferred PO' but not strictly required. Will confirm with finance.

thomas_account_manager: @nora_educom_procure can you paste the exact procurement wording? If they require a specific vendor form we can send it now.

invoice-bot: Invoice generation blocked: vendor_requires_po flag = true for customer_id EDU-00123.

nora_educom_procure: Hi — correct, our internal mandate requires a signed Purchase Authorization Form before Accounts Payable will process. We can issue PO once the form + VAT details are on file. VAT reg: GB123456789.

sean_engineer: I pulled the logs for the 403 when they tried to attach card. It looks like the request omitted Authorization header from the admin token. Example failing call (sanitized):
```
curl https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/billing/payment-methods -d '{"card":"xxxx"}'
# missing: -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```
Not caused by billing backend; IAM token expired/was removed from that user. Will DM them steps to re-create an API admin token.

mike_billing: Finance confirmed: we can create a proforma (interim) invoice PDF to allow their procurement to attach to the PO request, but final invoice requires PO or written procurement approval. I can produce a proforma with VAT lines.

thomas_account_manager: I'll send the vendor onboarding form + link to KYC here: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-onboard (internal link). @nora_educom_procure please complete and attach — that speeds PO issuance.

nora_educom_procure: Thanks, will complete vendor form today and target official PO by EOD tomorrow. Please include full VAT breakdown and our billing contact: finance@educom.edu.

mike_billing: Noted. I'll generate provisional invoice INV-PROFORMA-2026-0087 and attach VAT breakdown. This will not be recognized as final revenue.

invoice-bot: Provisional invoice created: INV-PROFORMA-2026-0087 (status: provisional).

olivia_support: Action items summarized: 1) @mike_billing send proforma with VAT, 2) @thomas_account_manager send vendor form & KYC link, 3) @sean_engineer assist EduCom admin to re-create API/admin token for billing UI, 4) wait for PO to close final invoice. Marking this thread pending PO. :thumbsup:

nora_educom_procure: Appreciate it. We'll reply here once PO is raised and attach it. If you can cc billing to finance@educom.edu that helps.

mike_billing: Will cc and follow up. Re-open the ticket if the 403 persists after token reset.

olivia_support: Closing the support thread as "awaiting PO" — will reopen on any new errors.
